verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes its own API reference at developers.anytype.io, with dated versions, a version picker, a changelog, and an OpenAPI document (openapi-v2.yaml) containing full schemas and documented error responses. The supplemental docs explicitly say no try-it console is published, so the interactive, runnable part of the story is not delivered. The OpenAPI file is also absent from the probed doc.anytype.io paths. missing for 10: interactive try-it console, runnable in-reference examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
